cloud_audit_model.description: Cloud Gemini model used via Firebase AI Logic ONLY_IN_CLOUD / PREFER_IN_CLOUD for deep audits on locally anonymized documents (remotely switchable between gemini-3.5-flash-lite and gemini-3.8-flash).

cloud_fallback_model.description: Fast cloud fallback model used when PREFER_ON_DEVICE falls back on unsupported devices.

default_policy_profile.description: Default local PII/PHI privacy redaction policy profile (medical | legal | finance | strict).

max_on_device_chars.description: Maximum character threshold for single-pass on-device Gemini Nano 4 triage before chunking or cloud escalation.

strict_zero_leak_block.description: When true, blocks any outbound cloud call if unredacted raw vault tokens are detected in the outbound payload.
